title: Holy Bible, Book Divine
description: Holy Bible, Book Divine in Tonic Solfa to ALETTA: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses, and a piano.
about: John Burton’s words date from 1803. The tune ALETTA is by William B. Bradbury (1858).
underlay: Ho-ly Bi-ble, book di__-vine, Pre-cious trea-sure, thou art__ mine; Mine, to tell me whence I came, Mine, to teach me what I__ am;

lines: Mine, to tell me whence I came,
Mine, to teach me what I am;
Mine, to chide me when I rove,
Mine, to show a Saviour’s love;
Mine art thou, to guide my feet,
Mine, to show by living faith
Mine, to tell of joys to come,
